footer.tagline: Pilates tranquilo y reflexivo para profesionales ocupados

hero.titleAccent: incluso en tu semana más ocupada.
hero.subtitle: Northside Pilates es un estudio tranquilo y reflexivo diseñado para profesionales que quieren resultados reales sin el ruido de un gimnasio grande. Clases pequeñas, instrucción precisa, cuarenta y cinco minutos bien aprovechados.
hero.imageAlt: Instructor guiando a un cliente a través de un ejercicio de Pilates en reformer en un estudio iluminado por el sol

classTypes.title: Seis formas de moverte, un estándar de atención.
classTypes.subtitle: Cada clase está limitada a ocho clientes, por lo que la instrucción se mantiene precisa y el ambiente tranquilo.

items.title: Reformer Flow
items.description: A full-body reformer sequence built around control and breath, designed to fit a working lunch hour.

items.title: Mat Fundamentals
items.description: Floor-based basics that build core strength and body awareness without equipment.

items.title: Strength & Stretch
items.description: Reformer and light resistance work paired with deep mobility to undo a day at your desk.

items.title: Lunchtime Express
items.description: A condensed reformer class engineered around the realities of a packed calendar.

items.title: Private Sessions
items.description: One-on-one programming for injury recovery, performance goals, or simply more attention.

items.title: Prenatal Pilates
items.description: Gentle, instructor-guided movement to support strength and comfort through pregnancy.

instructors.title: Ojos entrenados en cada repetición.
instructors.subtitle: Nuestros instructores provienen de fisioterapia, danza y deporte competitivo, y todos comparten un hábito: atención cercana y paciente.

items.name: Naomi Clarke
items.bio: Trained in classical and contemporary Pilates over a decade, Naomi built Northside around unhurried, precise coaching.

items.name: James Okafor
items.bio: A former physiotherapist, James focuses on alignment and injury-aware programming for every client.

items.name: Priya Anand
items.bio: Priya blends Pilates with strength fundamentals, popular with clients recovering from injury or burnout.

items.name: Leo Marchetti
items.bio: A former dancer, Leo brings a mobility-first approach to mat work and recovery-focused sessions.

pricing.title: Precios construidos alrededor de la consistencia.

freeTrial.title: Tu primera clase corre por nuestra cuenta.
freeTrial.subtitle: Llega quince minutos antes y un instructor te mostrará el reformer antes de que comience la clase. Sin colchoneta, sin zapatos, sin experiencia requerida.
freeTrial.successMessage: Ya está reservado. Revisa tu bandeja de entrada para los detalles del estudio y qué traer.
freeTrial.note: No se requiere pago. Confirmaremos tu lugar por correo electrónico dentro de un día hábil.

faq.title: Antes de tu primera visita.
faq.subtitle: Todo lo que nuestros clientes nuevos nos preguntan con más frecuencia.

items.question: What should I wear to my first class?
items.answer: Fitted, breathable layers and grip socks (available for purchase at the studio) work best for reformer work.

items.question: I have never done Pilates before. Is that a problem?
items.answer: Not at all. Every class is capped at eight people so instructors can adjust the work to your experience level.

items.question: How does the free trial work?
items.answer: Your first class is on us. Choose a time below and an instructor will walk you through the studio and equipment beforehand.

items.question: Can I freeze or cancel my membership?
items.answer: Unlimited and Founding memberships can be paused for up to two months a year, and cancelled with 30 days notice.

items.question: Do you offer early morning or evening classes?
items.answer: Yes, the schedule runs from 6am to 7:30pm on weekdays to fit around client meetings and commutes.

contact.title: ¿Preguntas antes de visitarnos?
contact.subtitle: Envía un mensaje y un miembro del equipo del estudio te responderá personalmente, generalmente el mismo día.
contact.successMessage: Gracias. Nos pondremos en contacto pronto.
